Context: 1. Admissibility.-

4. Rounding off.The monthly rate of family pension/ additional family pension is expressed in whole rupees, fraction of a rupee being rounded off to the next higher rupee. Where family pension is payable to more than one person, each share containing a fraction of a rupee should be rounded off to the next higher rupee. - Rule 50 (4) and (7) (b).
